messages:
Jordan Lee: Heads-up — Velori Health trial is blocked, customer can't finish onboarding. They hit repeated 422s during embeddings ingest.
Emily Carter: ugh, renewal is in 3 weeks for this account, flagging as renewal-risk. What scope? full ingest or a subset?
Jordan Lee: full ingest. They were onboarding 2k docs when process failed. Support trace id: trace_9f3b2. I pasted the last error:
Samir Patel: can you drop the error dump? I want to see model / shard info.
Jordan Lee: Sure — snippet:
```
2026-03-19T16:12:34Z ERROR ingest.worker: failed batch id=842 status=422 payload_size=8 model=redwood-embed-v1 shard=us-east-1a error=KVCacheMismatch: expected 16kb got 8kb
stack: ingest.process -> embeddings.submit -> http.post
```
Samir Patel: hmm KVCacheMismatch on embeddings path. Could be an upgraded runtime mismatch between dedicated pool and hosted variant. @Support Bot, link to infra incident if exists?
Support Bot: <https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-137|INC-2026-137> — deploying a hotpatch to embedding runtime in us-east-1, started 4m ago.
Rachel Nguyen: Ok - CS plan: we need a comms cadence and risk mitigation. Emily, propose a timeline for customer-facing update and an interim workaround.
Emily Carter: propose: immediate outreach within 30m to explain we're investigating + temporary rollback workaround (ingest in 100-doc chunks), followed by patch ETA from eng in 2-3 hours. If patch slips >6h, offer credit and dedicated onboarding session.
Nate Brooks: I'll prep the renewal owner note and set a flexible renewal touchpoint next week. Can you confirm impact on usage % so I can quantify risk to the AM?
Jordan Lee: Impact: onboarding stalled at 0% completion; trial feature gating blocks main flow. Customer reporting this is showstopper.
Samir Patel: short-term workaround: split batches to 100 docs and switch to embed model legacy-v0 for compatibility. Command we used for a test:
```
POST /v1/embeddings
payload { model: "redwood-embed-legacy-v0", batch_size: 100 }
```
Samir Patel: will run a quick smoke test on Velori sandbox and report within 20m.
Emily Carter: thanks. Rachel — draft comms: 1) acknowledging issue + ETA, 2) steps to opt into workaround, 3) offer to run ingest for them if they'd like a hand. Keep tone apologetic but action-oriented.
Rachel Nguyen: noted. I'll draft and send for review in 25m. Nate — please cc AM (Alex Rivera) and include renewal play options (credit, extended trial, onboarding session).
Nate Brooks: will do. Alex is on standby.
Support Bot: Incident INC-2026-137 updated: hotpatch applied to 2/3 nodes in us-east-1; monitoring for error recurrence. Next update in 15m.
Jordan Lee: small ask for CS: if patch doesn't clear, can CS accept a short-term manual ingest? I can coordinate support hours.
Emily Carter: yes — if Samir confirms manual ingest works, we offer to run it as an exp service until fix is stable. Marking priority: P1 -> escalation to CS urgent queue.
Rachel Nguyen: I'll create a short comms doc and incident playbook entry in the account folder. Sharing draft in this thread shortly.
Samir Patel: smoke test successful on sandbox with legacy-v0 + 100 doc batches. No 422s in 10 runs. I'll prepare runbook for manual ingest and hand it to Jordan.
Jordan Lee: great — I'll reach out to Velori now and propose workaround + offer manual assist. Will post customer reply here.
Emily Carter: thanks everyone. Keep updates short. We'll reconvene after next incident update from Support Bot or Samir's handoff.
